{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of arms and severity
tab = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity'])
print("Cross-tabulation of arm and severity:")
print(tab)

# Compute response rates by arm
treatment_responded = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_responded = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute raw difference in proportions
treatment_effect = treatment_responded - control_responded

# Also compute stratified response rates by severity
stratified = df_dedup.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nStratified response rates by arm and severity:")
print(stratified)

# Compute stratified treatment effect (within each severity level)
stratified_diff = stratified.loc['treatment'] - stratified.loc['control']
print("\nStratified treatment effect (treatment - control) by severity:")
print(stratified_diff)

# Return the raw difference and stratified results
treatment_effect, stratified_diff"}
